Job Description:

Your Platform

Sledgehammer Games is a leading developer in the video game industry, best known for its work on the Call of Duty franchise. Since its founding in 2009, the studio has delivered iconic titles like "Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare," "Call of Duty: WWII," and most recently, “Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.” We combine cutting-edge technology with creative vision to produce games that resonate with players worldwide. With a focus on creating high-quality multiplayer experiences and captivating single-player campaigns, we continue to shape the future of first-person shooters.

We are looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our studio team in Toronto, Canada. In this role you will partner closely with our teams at our other studio locations in the United States and Australia in the creation of epic content for some of the biggest games in the world. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment where your skills can make a real impact, we invite you to explore career opportunities with us.

Please note: This is not a remote role. This is a hybrid position based in our Toronto Studio, offering flexibility with a combination of in-studio and remote workdays. Permanent remote work is not available for this position.

Sledgehammer Games is part of the Activision family and is wholly owned by Microsoft. To learn more about our studio, please visit us at www.sledgehammergames.com or search for Sledgehammer Games on your favorite social media platform.

Your Mission

Our team is seeking a dedicated and passionate AI Engineer who will work closely with other engineers and content teams to expand our AI systems to create new and exciting experiences for our players. This is an excellent opportunity to work with a passionate engineering team on the world’s most popular game franchises! We'd like to speak with you!

•

Work with AI engineering teams to expand our AI technology to push the limits of what our AI can currently do

•

Work alongside our design and content teams to develop new AI characters and behaviors

•

Implement, debug and optimize major systems in C/C++ and other languages in the context of a large cross platform codebase

•

Design and implement optimized AI systems

•

Provide mentorship to less experienced engineers

Player Profile

•

Excellent C++ programing skills, with knowledge of algorithms and data structures

•

Fluency in 3D math and algebra, related to game programming

•

Strong design sensibilities and outstanding communication skills.

•

A passion for making video games

•

Validated debugging skills

•

Experience extending an established code base

•

5+ years of experience in games or real-time AI

•

1+ shipped games

•

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering or Math related field

Bonus Points

•

Expertise in one or more of the following areas:

•

AI systems in a networked environment

•

Animation – blend trees, IK, motion matching

•

AI navigation mesh generation and pathfinding

•

AI controlled vehicles

•

Optimization

•

Experience with scripting languages

•

Console development experience

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Activision Blizzard, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

jobs.description: You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations. Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide—from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide - Develop, test, and deploy high-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies - Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems - Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle—from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics. About the team We are a group of engineers committed to building and maintaining the tax platform that serves as the backbone for tax compliance across Amazon's global operations. Our team values technical depth, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. We work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, and engineers across Amazon to understand evolving tax requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. We're focused on staying ahead of complex, ever-changing global tax regulations while continuously improving system performance and reliability. When you join us, you'll work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, take ownership of their work, and support one another in solving challenging problems. We're building the future of tax technology at scale, and we're excited to have you contribute your skills and perspective to this mission.

The opportunity

Unity powers the majority of top mobile games and underpins real-time 3D experiences in nearly every country on earth. When studios and developers decide how to build, ship, and monetize, Unity is usually what they choose. The tools we build shape what the entire industry can make.

Product marketing at Unity spans the engine developers build in, the services they use to ship and operate live games, the ecosystem of tools and partners around them, and the AI capabilities now being built into all of it. Each of those reaches a technical audience that evaluates claims carefully and has little patience for marketing that outruns the product.

We are looking for an experienced product marketer to take on a defined body of that work on a contract basis. You will pick up a product area or a set of launches, own the marketing for it end to end, and produce work that ships. This is a role for someone who can arrive with limited context, ask the right questions quickly, and start producing positioning, launch plans and enablement material without waiting to be told how.

Scope of the engagement

• Duration: initial engagement of 1yr, with the possibility of extension based on business need.
• Location: fully remote or near one of our many hub locations: NYC, SF, MTV, MTL, etc. We ask for meaningful working-hour overlap with US time zones, since product and marketing reviews run on that clock.
• Commitment: full-time equivalent hours for the duration of the engagement.

What you'll be doing

• Positioning and narrative — Own the positioning and messaging for the product areas assigned to you. Translate technical capability into obvious workflow value, and write the narrative that Sales, Community and Content all work from.
• Go-to-market execution — Lead go-to-market for launches, betas and feature rollouts: tiering, audience targeting, channel plan, enablement and launch-day execution, followed by an honest read on what worked.
• Audience definition — Define precisely who a product is for, from indie creators to technical directors, and document it clearly enough that other teams can act on it without reinterpreting it.
• Developer credibility — Developers are inherently skeptical of marketing claims, and increasingly so of AI claims. Write messaging that earns credibility with practitioners rather than hyping past them, working with Community and DevRel to meet developers where the real discussions happen.
• Competitive and market intelligence — Track the relevant landscape and turn market shifts into sharp positioning and usable sales material.
• Voice of the customer — Turn forum threads, interviews and community feedback into signal that product and marketing teams can actually use.
• Enablement and content — Equip Sales, Success and Support with pitch decks, battlecards and objection handling. Partner with Content marketing on launch assets and developer-facing material.
• Partner and ecosystem marketing — Where an initiative involves third-party tools or platform partners, drive the joint go-to-market and co-marketing motion.
• Measurement — Work with Product and Analytics to define what success looks like for each launch in advance, and report against it afterwards.

What we're looking for

• 7-9 years in product marketing or go-to-market roles, with a clear track record of owning a product line or a major launch end to end.
• Game production fluency — a background in games, or a deep grasp of modern development pipelines and creator workflows. Strongly preferred.
• Proven experience marketing to technical audiences such as developers, engineers or technical artists, and the credibility to win over users whose default posture is skepticism.
• Exceptional writing. You can turn complex technology into a crisp, obvious narrative across a launch page, a keynote section, a battlecard or a Slack thread with engineers.
• Independent operator. Contract engagements come with less context and less standing than a permanent role. You need to be comfortable getting yourself oriented, driving work forward across teams you have just met, and producing finished artifacts rather than waiting for direction.
• High comfort with ambiguity, including early-stage products where the strategy is still moving and the roadmap shifts underneath you.
• Strong data literacy. You can set the right metrics, read performance signals honestly, and change course on evidence.
• Strong with AI tools such as Claude Code, Gemini or similar, and a practical sense of how to use them to move faster without letting the output go out unchecked.

Nice to have

• Platform and ecosystem go-to-market — experience marketing developer platforms, game engines, SDKs or plugin ecosystems.
• Direct experience with AI or ML products, and the technical judgment to tell a production-ready capability from a good demo.
• Hands-on creation experience — you have shipped something in Unity or a comparable real-time creation tool.
• Partner co-marketing — a track record running joint go-to-market motions with major technology partners.
• Category creation — experience taking a product through a market shift and educating users on a new way of working.
• Prior contract or consulting experience inside a large matrixed organisation, where you have had to be effective without formal authority.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-impact role driving AI adoption across our Financial Services segment. As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager for FSI, you'll be the strategic partner and a trusted advisor to our most complex customers with a portfolio spanning Banking, Insurance, Asset & Wealth Management, and Data Providers — helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - Claude Enterprise, Claude Code, and API.

You'll work with organizations across diverse sub-segments that are transforming their businesses with AI technology. Developing genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

Responsibilities:

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
• Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Claude for Enterprise, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
• Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and their industry vertical to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
• Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments
• Serve as the customer's thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic's product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs
• Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
• Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers and Sales to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
• Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
• Develop scalable engagement strategies and playbooks for your Industry portfolio, balancing high-touch strategic accounts with efficient coverage models to maximize impact across all customers

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering
• Experience working with enterprises in Financial Services
• Deep understanding of FSI regulatory, risk, and compliance needs
• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users
• Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
• Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
• Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes
• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
• A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality—you're a true team player

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$200,000—$265,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Industrial Pipefitter to support the buildout of SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will install large industrial piping systems and keep construction moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with mechanical, welding, structural, electrical, and operations teams to fit, hang, and test pipe from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Install large-bore industrial piping (process, mechanical, utility, and related systems): measure, cut, bevel, fit, hang, and make up joints per drawings and specs.
• Perform flange, groove, thread, and welded-joint fit-up; align pipe, set gaps, and prep joints for the welding crew.
• Install valves, fittings, hangers, supports, strut, and anchors; hang pipe racks and supports plumb and on grade.
• Read isometric, spool, and arrangement drawings; field-route as directed and flag drawing conflicts before install.
• Support hydro, pneumatic, and service tests: install blinds and test packs, walk lines, and repair leaks.
• Stage, move, and inventory pipe, valves, hangers, insulation, tools, and equipment; keep laydown yards and mechanical rooms orderly.
• Assist with equipment set for pumps, cooling towers, air handlers, and related mechanical gear, including bolt-up of suction and discharge piping.
• Open and close work areas: protection, debris removal, scrap segregation, and end-of-shift reset so the next crew can start immediately.
• Follow LOTO, PPE, and permit rules; do not work on live systems without authorization.
• Report damaged material, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.
• Support punch-list work and cleanup through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years installing large industrial or commercial piping OR completion of a recognized pipefitter apprenticeship, OR equivalent military experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience fitting and installing welded, flanged, grooved, and/or threaded pipe, including hangers and supports.
• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.
• Ability to use pipefitting hand tools, power tools, bevelers, and material-handling equipment safely.
• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including LOTO and permits.
• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.
• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.
• Experience on large-bore welded industrial piping (carbon and/or stainless) and equipment connections (pumps, air handlers, cooling towers, skids).
• Ability to read isometric, spool, and P&ID drawings.
• UA, NCCER, or equivalent pipefitter credential.
• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.
• Familiarity with hot-work, hydrotest, and flange-management practices.
• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI data center construction sites and remain onsite during peak construction phases.
• Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift and position moderate loads, stand and walk for a full shift, and wear PPE for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation.

This role focuses on driving operational excellence in contract lifecycle management, ensuring that contract renewals are anticipated, structured, and optimized. Acting as a key partner to IT Vendor Management, Procurement, and Finance teams, the role will help improve contract visibility, support decision-making through data insights, and enable better cost and usage optimization.

What you’ll do

Contract Lifecycle Coordination & Project Management

• Own and drive the renewal tracking and planning for a portfolio of IT contracts (timeline management, stakeholder alignment, risk anticipation).
• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders (IT, Procurement, Legal, Finance) to ensure smooth and timely contract renewals.
• Support business teams in preparing contract renewals, ensuring they challenge scope, usage, and commercial conditions.
• Lead end-to-end management of smaller contracts, from preparation to renewal, in collaboration with Procurement.
• Contribute to defining and implementing contract renewal processes, guidelines, and best practices for internal stakeholders.
• Ensure proper documentation and visibility of contract activities (e.g., Confluence one-pagers, renewal summaries).

Contract Analysis & Optimization

• Analyze contract usage (e.g., licenses, infrastructure usage) to identify optimization opportunities and cost-saving initiatives.
• Support tracking of financial commitments vs. actual consumption, highlighting risks and optimization levers.
• Build and maintain simple dashboards or reports (Excel / Power BI as a plus) to provide visibility on contract performance and usage trends.
• Research licensing models, market benchmarks, and alternative options to support optimization and informed decision-making.
• Identify aging or under-optimized contracts and proactively highlight improvement opportunities.

Vendor Interaction & Support

• Manage day-to-day interactions with smaller vendors and support vendor follow-ups.
• Participate in vendor discussions and renewals in collaboration with Procurement.
• Contribute to preparation activities for larger strategic contracts (data gathering, usage insights, internal alignment).

What you’ll bring:

• Proven experience in IT project management, contract management, procurement, or a related field.
• Experience working in cross-functional environments (IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal).
• Exposure to contract lifecycle management and/or vendor-related topics.

Project Management & Coordination

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple timelines, stakeholders, and priorities.
• Ability to structure processes and bring clarity to complex or unstructured topics.
• Comfortable driving topics autonomously after ramp-up.

Analytical & Data Skills

• Ability to analyze data and translate it into actionable insights.
• Experience with Excel required; exposure to Power BI or data visualization tools is a plus.
• Interest in understanding license models, consumption-based pricing, and cost optimization levers.

Contract & Business Understanding

• Basic understanding of contractual terms, vendor processes, and procurement workflows.
• Ability to support contract renewals by challenging usage, scope, and business needs.
• Awareness of negotiation processes is a plus (no direct negotiation ownership required).

In addition, the Clinical Research Physician works with research scientists to identify lead compounds and clinical candidates and plan pre-clinical studies. Core tasks will be delegated based on level of experience. Other activities include internal training activities, peer-review of clinical protocols and reports, and ad hoc scientific consultation within Lilly. The CRP works with late stage development colleagues to plan for meeting patient needs through clinical studies, and outcomes and pharmacoeconomic research. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervision regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position. Clinical Planning Contribute to the development of the overall strategy and clinical plan for development of clinical compounds, focusing on studies required for product decision. Support preparation of high-level plan for phase Ill studies. Collaborate with local clinical research staff, consultants and clinical investigators in the design, conduct and reporting of global Phase lb and Ila/IIb clinical trials (e.g., sample size, patient commitment, timelines, grants, and governance review interactions). Work closely with discovery research scientists in the development of basic research strategies, clinical candidate compound selection, and pre-clinical development. Collaborate with non-clinical pharmacologists to translate observations from animal experiments to human clinical studies (biomarker development) in the area therapeutic area of responsibility. Collaborate with drug disposition scientist to conduct pharmacokinetic and drug metabolism studies of drug candidates in humans. Clinical Research/Trial Execution and Support Design and oversee implementation of Phase lb and Ila/IIb clinical studies. Design and write clinical trial protocols. Design and oversee implementation methods for development and biomarker qualification studies. Collaborate with local clinical research staff, statisticians, health outcomes research scientists and selected consultants and/or investigators in the development of protocols, and data collection requirements. Participate in investigator identification and selection, in conjunction with clinical team. Understand and actively address the unsolicited scientific information needs of external health care professionals according to guidelines above. Participate in reporting of clinical trial data in Clinical Trial Registry activities. Consider, review or develop pharmacoepidemiologic (quality of life, cost/effectiveness) and health economic aspects. Support the planning of symposia, advisory board meetings, and other meetings with health care professionals. Participate in data analysis, development of scientific data dissemination and preparation of final reports. Support development of slide sets and publications (abstracts, posters, manuscripts). Provide congress support (e.g., availability to answer questions at exhibits, provide oral and poster presentations, staff medical booth, meet thought leaders, and participate in customer events). Provide medical expertise to regulatory scientists. Business/ customer support Understand the scientific/medical needs of all CMR Program Phase customers (payers, patients, health care providers Provide advice and consultation to global business unit with regard to potential markets for development compounds and in-licensed projects or compounds. Support business development in collaboration with the regulatory and corporate affairs group. Establish and maintain appropriate collaborations and relationships with external experts, thought leaders, and the general medical community on a national and possibly international basis. Provide consultation to health outcomes staff, marketing professionals, and management regarding the potential medical need served by responsible therapeutic area drug candidates. Knowledge of current trends and projections for clinical practice and access in the therapeutic area(s) relevant to the development projects. 회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

CS Handyman은 고객이 상품 사용 중 겪는 다양한 문제를 신속하고 정확하게 해결할 수 있도록 지원하는 전문 Troubleshooting 서비스입니다. 고객 문의 데이터와 현장 운영 경험을 기반으로 문제 해결 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고, 상담 품질 및 고객 경험 향상을 통해 최고의 서비스 경험을 제공합니다.

jobs.description:
Oxy produces, markets and transports oil and natural gas to maximize value and provide resources fundamental to life. The company leverages its global leadership in carbon management to advance lower-carbon technologies and products. Headquartered in Houston, Oxy primarily operates in the United States, Middle East and North Africa. To learn more, visit Oxy

Oxy strives to attract and retain talented employees by investing in their professional development and providing rewarding opportunities for personal growth. Our goal is to meet the highest employer standards by ensuring the health and safety of our employees, protecting the environment and positively impacting our communities where we do business.

The UAS Operations Team Leader is responsible for the leadership, daily management, and continuous advancement of the organization's internal unmanned aircraft systems (UAS/drone) program. This role serves as the primary technical authority and operational leader for all drone-based activities supporting Oxy’s oil and gas operations including, facility and well pad imaging, pipeline and midstream infrastructure inspections, drone based compliance inspections, electrical transmission and distribution asset imaging and inspections, offshore inspections, and related industrial inspection programs.

The Team Leader ensures all UAS operations are executed to the standards and procedure set forth by Oxy and result in safe, efficient, and compliant day to day operations. This individual manages a team of certified pilots and mission specialists, maintains a multi-platform fleet of UAS infrastructure, drives capability development, interfaces with internal stakeholders and is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of actionable inspection data and analytical products to operations, asset integrity, and engineering teams.

Core Responsibilities:

Safety and Compliance

•

Serve as the primary safety authority for all UAS operations, establishing and enforcing a comprehensive Safety Management System (SMS) aligned with company HSE and Aviation policies and industry best practices.

•

Ensure full compliance with FAA Part 107 regulations, BVLOS waivers, COAs, and any applicable international aviation authority requirements for cross-border or offshore operations.

•

Develop, maintain, and enforce UAS-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Response Procedures (ERPs), and Mission Risk Assessments (MRAs) for all operation types.

•

Improve upon and support pre-mission hazard identification and risk mitigation processes, including airspace conflict analysis, weather assessment, electromagnetic interference evaluation, and site-specific hazard reviews.

•

Maintain thorough incident investigation protocols; lead or delegate root cause analysis and corrective action implementation for any UAS-related incident, near-miss, or equipment loss.

•

Enforce strict adherence to Process Safety Management (PSM) and OSHA regulations when operating in and around hazardous energy environments (refineries, compressor stations, tank farms, gas plants).

•

Ensure pilots and crew maintain current certifications, medical fitness (where applicable), and substance abuse compliance per company policy.

Fleet and Asset Management

•

Own the full lifecycle management of the UAS fleet, including sensor packages and associated payloads.

•

Establish procurement, maintenance, and end-of-life procedures

•

Work with management to establish routine refreshes of critical equipment to ensure fleet and mission readiness

•

Develop and enforce scheduled preventive maintenance programs, component lifecycle tracking (motor hours, prop cycles, battery charge cycles), and mandatory inspection intervals for each platform class.

•

Oversee firmware and software updates across the fleet, evaluating and validating changes in a controlled test environment prior to operational deployment.

•

Manage payload inventory including RGB cameras, lighting kits, radiometric thermal imagers, LiDAR scanners, methane/gas detection sensors

•

Manage secure transport, storage, and readiness of equipment for rapid field deployment including cases, charging infrastructure, and environmental storage requirements.

•

Maintain insurance documentation and records for all airframes; interface with risk management and aviation as needed.

Pilot Management and Training

•

Recruit, hire, onboard, and manage a team of FAA Part 107-certified UAS pilots and mission specialists, ensuring adequate coverage for operational demand across multiple simultaneous campaigns.

•

Develop and administer a structured internal pilot proficiency program encompassing initial qualification, platform type ratings, mission category endorsements, and annual recurrency requirements.

•

Conduct regular proficiency evaluations, standardization flights, and documented check for all pilots; maintain individual pilot training records and currency logs.

•

Ensure training programs exists and are available for fleet pilots and staff pilots

•

Establish a mentorship and career progression pathway for junior pilots to advance to mission-lead and senior pilot roles.

•

Train pilots and data technicians on data collection protocols, payload operation, sensor calibration, etc.

•

Identify and manage approved external training providers and recurrency programs to supplement internal capability development.

•

Administer performance reviews, identify skill gaps, and implement individual development plans for all direct reports as needed.

•

Foster a culture of continuous learning, safety-first decision-making, and operational excellence across the entire UAS team.

Day-to-Day Operations Management

•

Oversee and direct all daily UAS flight operations including pre-mission planning, mission execution, post-mission data processing, and associated debriefs.

•

Coordinate with site operations, mechanical integrity, HSE, pipeline integrity, facilities maintenance, and electrical transmission teams to align drone mission execution with site access, permit-to-work (PTW), and operational windows.

•

Manage simultaneous field campaigns across multiple asset types and geographies, including remote pipeline corridors, offshore platforms, tank batteries, compressor stations, substations, and transmission towers.

•

Ensure all flight operations are logged in a digital operations management system, capturing flight hours, battery cycles, anomalies, and personnel records in compliance with FAA and company documentation requirements.

•

Monitor real-time weather conditions, NOTAMs, TFRs, and airspace status for all active and planned operation areas; make go/no-go decisions with appropriate authority.

•

Establish and enforce strict pre-flight checklists, mission briefing standards, and post-flight debrief protocols.

Scheduling, Backlog Management & Prioritization

•

Maintain and communicate a rolling backlog and mission queue integrating requests from multiple internal customers including asset integrity, pipeline operations, electrical transmission, HSE, and engineering.

•

Design and implement a structured intake and prioritization framework that accounts for regulatory inspection intervals, risk-ranked asset criticality, operational urgency, weather windows, and resource availability.

•

Build and manage a detailed master schedule for all UAS operations, balancing planned inspection programs, reactive/emergency response deployments, and capability development activities.

•

Produce monthly and quarterly operational forecasts for crew utilization, flight hours, equipment usage, and data delivery timelines; communicate proactively with stakeholders on scheduling constraints.

•

Triage and respond to unplanned inspection requests (e.g., leak detection, post-storm damage assessment, pre-turnaround surveys, incident response support) with rapid mobilization capability.

•

Coordinate with planning and maintenance departments to align UAS access windows with planned outages, turnarounds, maintenance campaigns, and construction activities to maximize operational efficiency.

•

Track open work orders and inspection assignments to completion, escalating blockers and resource conflicts to management with clear recommendations.

•

Maintain KPI dashboards tracking planned vs. actual flight hours, mission completion rates, backlog age, schedule adherence, and data delivery cycle times.

Data Processing, Management and Delivery

•

Work and coordinate with support staff to ensure a robust data pipeline from raw sensor capture through processing, quality assurance, and delivery to end-user stakeholders.

•

Manage delivery of data products to GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS), asset management systems (SAP PM) and inspection management platforms. Seek ways to integrate UAS data, images and findings into standardized workflows.

•

Work with support staff to ensure data governance standards including file naming conventions, metadata tagging, coordinate reference system (CRS) management, and long-term archive and retrieval procedures.

•

Work with support staff to ensure QA/QC processes for all data deliverables, including independent review protocols and defect detection validation against manual inspection findings where available.

•

Track data delivery SLAs against stakeholder commitments; report on turnaround time KPIs and identify bottlenecks in the processing workflow.

Capabilities Development and Innovation

•

Lead the research, evaluation, and integration of emerging UAS technologies, including advanced payload sensors, autonomous/semi-autonomous flight systems, AI-assisted detection, and drone dock systems.

•

Develop business cases and ROI analyses for new capability investments, comparing drone-based approaches against traditional inspection methods in terms of cost, cycle time, data quality, and safety risk reduction.

•

Work with relevant teams to evaluate AI/ML-powered automated recognition platforms for integration into the inspection data workflow.

•

Develop and socialize internal technical standards for UAS-based inspection methodologies and data products to achieve consistency across asset classes and operating regions.

Recruitment Fraud

It has come to our attention various individuals and/or organizations are contacting people falsely pretending to recruit on behalf of Oxy. Please be aware that these recruiting scams and communications do not originate nor are they associated with our recruitment process. All Oxy job postings and offers will require a completed application through our company website.

Oxy does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruiting process. We will never:

• Ask you to pay for applications, interviews, meetings, processing, training or for any other fees

• Use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind or

• Request personal information such as passport and bank account details at an early stage of our recruitment process.

We recommend against responding to unsolicited business propositions or offers from people you don't know. Do not disclose your personal or financial details. If you believe you have been the victim of a recruiting scam, please contact your local police department.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.
